item.title: Beaconsfield — History and How It's Changed
item.description:

What Beaconsfield Was Originally

Is Beaconsfield Expensive?

Beaconsfield sits somewhere in the middle of Melbourne’s cost spectrum. It’s not cheap, but it’s not going to break the bank either — assuming you’re realistic about expectations.
